definitions.explanation: A military leader or commander, especially one from Japanese feudal history. Frequently used when discussing the Sengoku (Warring States) period and other eras of Japanese history.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦国|せんごく}→戦国：27122_sengoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{武将|ぶしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I'm interested in Sengoku-era military commanders.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{武将|ぶしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{築|きず}いた→築く：02046_kizuku⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This castle was built by a famous warlord.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{武将|ぶしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{天下|てんか}{統一|とういつ}→天下統一：20946_tenkatouitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}して→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧⟦{争|あらそ}う→争う：01866_arasou⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}かれる→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: Historical dramas depict many military commanders competing to unify the country.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used when discussing Japanese feudal history, particularly the Sengoku period (1467–1615). Figures like {織田|おだ}{信長|のぶなが}, {豊臣|とよとみ}{秀吉|ひでよし}, and {徳川|とくがわ}{家康|いえやす} are among the most famous {武将|ぶしょう}. Also used in video games and anime set in historical periods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{戦国|せんごく}→戦国：27122_sengoku⟧{武将|ぶしょう}: Sengoku-era military commander
- {名|めい}{武将|ぶしょう}: famous commander
- {武将|ぶしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧: statue of a military commander
